# Benchmark summary (generated by run_benchmark.py)

Median of 14 warm runs, `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE)` execution time, parallel workers off.

| Query | What it does | Before (ms) | After (ms) | Speed-up | Scans before -> after |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Q1 | Top 10 scorers in 2025/26 (join + aggregate) | 7.0 | 6.9 | 1.0x | Seq Scan -> Index Scan, Seq Scan |
| Q2 | League table rebuilt from raw results (UNION ALL + CASE) | 0.5 | 0.4 | 1.1x | Seq Scan -> Index Scan, Seq Scan |
| Q3 | Which teams over/under-performed their xG in 2025/26? | 0.7 | 0.6 | 1.1x | Seq Scan -> Index Scan, Seq Scan |
| Q4 | Rolling 5-match points form for one team (window function) | 0.1 | 0.1 | 1.1x | Seq Scan -> Index Scan |
| Q5 | Successful passes by one busy player (large-table filter) | 73.8 | 0.6 | 123.7x | Seq Scan -> Index Only Scan |
| Q6 | Pass network for one match (edges between passers and receivers) | 77.2 | 0.2 | 358.1x | Seq Scan -> Index Scan |
| Q7 | Each team's top scorer, correlated subquery version | 477.8 | 243.7 | 2.0x | Seq Scan -> Bitmap Heap Scan, Index Scan, Seq Scan |
| Q7b | Each team's top scorer, rewritten with a window function | 4.6 | 4.3 | 1.1x | Index Scan, Seq Scan -> Index Scan, Seq Scan |
| Q8 | All goals scored by headers in the 80th minute or later (partial-index candidate) | 1.6 | 0.0 | 100.3x | Seq Scan -> Index Only Scan |
